request: Analyze GSE208714 for PMID 36611093 (Early-life exercise primes the murine neural epigenome to facilitate gene expression and hippocampal memory consolidation.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.
decision_maker: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) Claude Code subagent session

final.assay: TRAP-seq (translating mRNA, Emx1-NuTRAP excitatory neurons), polyA RNA-seq, NovaSeq 100 bp PE; separate bulk RNA-seq of wild-type dorsal hippocampus for the OLM experiment

wild_type_OLM_experiment: juvenile P21-27 / adolescent P35-41 exercise 3 min OLM

final.sample_inclusion: SIT TRAP-seq: 4 ELE + 4 sedentary deposited; PCA outliers removed 2 sedentary and 1 ELE, leaving n = 2 sedentary and n = 3 ELE (FIG4 legend; S4.1.16.1.p2). Separate isolation: n = 3 mice per group (S4.1.7.p1, FIG2 legend f).
final.primary_estimand: Effect of early-life voluntary wheel running (P21-41) vs sedentary housing on translating mRNA in Emx1+ hippocampal neurons at P42, SIT isolation (S2.4.p1, FIG4a).
planned_contrasts: SIT TRAP-seq ELE vs sedentary (S2.4.p1, FIG4a; paper: 297 up, 338 down; n = 3 ELE vs 2 sed after outlier removal)
Separate-isolation TRAP-seq ELE vs sedentary (S2.2.p3, FIG2f-g; counts only in Supplementary Data 3)
Separate isolation, ELE vs sedentary within left and within right hemisphere, plus hemisphere x exercise LRT / 2-way ANOVA (S2.3.p1, S4.1.16.1.p3-p4; LRT exercise = 565, 2-way ANOVA exercise = 1583)
Wild-type bulk RNA-seq OLM experiment, each group vs sedentary no-OLM (S2.6, FIG6b)
final.repeated_measure_unit: mouse; in separate isolation the two hemispheres of one mouse went to TRAP and INTACT respectively (S4.1.7.p1), so RNA libraries are one per mouse
final.normalization: DESeq2 size factors; counts by GenomicAlignments summarizeOverlaps (S4.1.16.1.p2)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 1.32.0, negative binomial Wald test, ~ exercise (S4.1.16.1.p2)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Paper read in full (S2.1-S2.6, S4.1.3-S4.1.16, DA.p1). The primary RNA estimand is the SIT TRAP-seq ELE vs sedentary contrast in S2.4.p1/FIG4a with DESeq2 Wald, raw p < 0.05 and |log2FC| > log2(1.3). The paper excluded PCA outliers (2 sed, 1 ELE) without naming them, leaving 2 vs 3.

alignment.reasoning: The matrix column names are lab mouse IDs (NT6.303, TG9.1.3, ...) that appear nowhere in the GEO metadata, SOFT, BioSample, SRA run info, SRA original file names, or the CUT&RUN companion series. No metadata column or index equals or contains them, so no exact or named-key match exists. The prefixes NT (6 columns) and TG (14 columns) do not split into any metadata grouping (SIT 4+4, separate 6+6, exercised 10 / sedentary 10), so they cannot be decoded as group labels. The only alternatives are matching by column order or inferring labels from expression or library size, and both are forbidden: either would silently assign exercise labels to the wrong animals. The paper's outlier exclusion (2 sed, 1 ELE) also names no samples, so even the paper's 3-vs-2 sample set cannot be rebuilt. One specific fact (the lab-ID to GSM key) would unblock the case, so it stops as manual_review rather than refused.

Needs the lab-ID to sample key (paper Supplementary Data or authors).
